INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information: Active and passive voice.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information: Note Making, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. Only memorise without using the language
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
